description_en: Queries the servers that have the anti-ransomware backup policy enabled
description_zh: 调用DescribeUserBackupMachines接口查询启用了防勒索备份策略的服务器
name: DescribeUserBackupMachines

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder. The member accounts are Alibaba Cloud accounts.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

Machines.description_en: The information about the servers that have the backup policy enabled
Machines.description_zh: 启用备份策略的服务器的信息

Id.description_en: The ID of the policy enabled for the server

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the policy enabled for the server
PolicyName.description_zh: 服务器启用的策略的名称

Uuid.description_en: The UUID of the server that has the backup policy enabled
Uuid.description_zh: 已启用备份策略的服务器的UUID

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
